errors.text: The proposed laboratory strain-rate range of 10^-4–10^-1 s^-1 and 500–700 °C plateau do not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8–10^10 s^-1 and 10–600 K.

It predicts low-temperature twinning and bulk FCC-to-HCP transformation, whereas the target mechanism is Shockley-partial glide producing local stacking-fault-associated HCP-like signatures without twinning or bulk phase transformation.
It predicts strong low-temperature yield-rate sensitivity, directly opposing the target result that yield strength is nearly rate-insensitive across the simulated rate range.
The assumed processed, potentially precipitate-containing or polycrystalline microstructure is incompatible with the periodic FeNiCrMn single-crystal model.

The cited evidence primarily concerns quinary CoCrFeMnNi nanowires, additively manufactured material, compression, or pressure-induced transformation and does not establish the proposed strain-rate-insensitivity plateau or dynamic-recovery balance in equiatomic FeNiCrMn.
